objectives.description: Acquire/release bracket around run-all.sh invocation in gate8_run()
Invoke deployed task-lock.sh, presence-guarded, matching gate 9/10 pattern
Skip on VERIFY_DEPLOY_NESTED/inherited GATE_MUTEX_HELD; export GATE_MUTEX_HELD=1 on real acquisition
Fail-open WARNING line on acquire failure
Release on every exit path (explicit, not trap)
Document bracket in gate8_run() header comment

approaches_tried.approach: First draft checked VERIFY_DEPLOY_NESTED directly inside gate8_run()
approaches_tried.reason: VERIFY_DEPLOY_NESTED is unconditionally exported near the top of verify-deploy.sh (its own pre-existing self-nesting guard) long before gate8_run() executes, so the check always read 1 regardless of true entry state. Confirmed live: a real --only-gate 8 run against the deployed tree showed run-all.sh itself (session run-all-$$) as the .gate-lock owner, not verify-deploy.sh, proving gate8_run()'s own acquire was always silently skipped. Fixed by capturing VERIFY_DEPLOY_WAS_NESTED_AT_ENTRY before the unconditional export and testing that captured value instead, mirroring run-all.sh's own RUN_ALL_WAS_NESTED_AT_ENTRY fix from Phase 2. Re-verified live after the fix: owner file correctly showed verify-deploy-gate8-$$ as the acquiring session.

verification_evidence.skip_slow_only_gate_8: [SKIP] line printed, no .gate-lock created (checked against real deployed tree, --skip-slow branch exits before the bracket is ever reached)
verification_evidence.real_only_gate_8_post_fix: owner file showed session=verify-deploy-gate8-<pid>; .gate-lock absent after exit; run-all.sh itself ran as guest (no nested Note, no second acquire)
